markers.description: Lower 60-minute SJ01 relative-humidity variability around some RF-quality drop definitions compared with same-clock controls.

outcome_sensitivity.all6: same negative direction; pre association survives four-definition Bonferroni
outcome_sensitivity.analog4: same negative direction in 3/4 folds; pre association does not survive four-definition Bonferroni
outcome_sensitivity.ul3: same negative direction in 3/4 folds; pre association survives four-definition Bonferroni

markers.interpretation: The association is internally interesting but depends on RF outcome construction and lacks clean temporal precedence. It is not eligible as a precursor or validated context marker.
markers.claim_limit: May be reported only as an exploratory, outcome-definition-sensitive context association.
